reason: The cited evidence shows that higher ΔSmix can improve Jc in RE123 superconductors (E2, E3), but E1 directly contradicts the core premise by showing that higher ΔSmix reduces Tc and the Sommerfeld constant. No cited evidence supports the mechanistic link between configurational entropy, local lattice distortions, and enhanced electron–phonon coupling in the proposed alloy system.
premises: Increasing configurational entropy induces local lattice distortions
Local lattice distortions enhance electron–phonon coupling
